instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/seed_ss_gui_13_dogbone.dxf and continue editing that drawing rather than starting from an empty document. Use the existing circles, tangent lines, and center marks in the file to create one closed dogbone outer outline with left and right outside circles of radius 20 centered at (30,30) and (110,30), connected by two common tangent lines. Add one diameter 8 hole at the center of each outside circle. Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. Save the completed drawing as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_13.dxf.
